Book Title: Donald Duck Little Golden Book Favorites (Disney Classic)
Author: Golden Books, Disney Storybook Art Team
Summary: Celebrate Donald Duck's 90th anniversary with this classic Little Golden Book Collection, featuring three vintage out-of-print stories starring Walt Disney’s Donald Duck! Customer Reviews (Text): Customers love the book's interactive elements, with different textures on each page and an adorable story that captivates children. Moreover, the book is particularly suitable for toddlers. However, the sticky candy cane page receives mixed reactions from customers. Additionally, the book's length receives mixed feedback, with some finding it not too long while others note it's smaller than expected.
